name: Claire Stainbach
original_name: クレア・スタインベック
source:
Claire is a teacher of general education courses in the city's library. Even though she usually gives the impression of a strict and cold educated woman, Claire actually likes getting drunk in a bar. At times like that she becomes a completely different person. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=2784]Getchu[/url].]
